name: Rakabot
author: ozz1ee
description: Your Rakazo roster in the bar: every bot drawn as its own avatar, with an expression for its state and one keypress to the server.

barWidget.description: Bots waiting on you appear in the bar as their own avatars - the shape and colour they have in Rakazo - and the panel lists every bot and group by section with its last message.

schema.label: What sits beside the logo
schema.description: The Rakazo logo is always shown. To its right: avatars = the bots waiting on you, as themselves; count = how many are waiting; none = the logo alone.

schema.label: Panel order
schema.description: attention = bots waiting on you first, longest wait at the top, then a rule and everyone else by recency; channels = the sections you set up in Rakazo; flat = purely by last message.

schema.label: Group the panel by section
schema.description: Use the sections you set up in Rakazo's sidebar. Off sorts every bot together, most urgent first.

schema.label: Most avatars to show in the bar
